paite: "Mihat aw, bang achia thil hihkhelh suang na hia! Pathian zahngaihna tung a gitlouhna bangziak a suang?
heading: Edom Mi Doeg, Saul Kiang A Va Hoh A, Ahimelek Inn Ah David Ahoh Chih Agen Nung A. David La / Pathian Thukhenna Leh Hehpihna
english: For the Chief Musician. A contemplation by David, when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, “David has come to Ahimelech’s house.” Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man? God’s loving kindness endures continually.

paite: Na lei in niteng in gilou-salou asuangtuah nak; mulmet tem hiamtak khemhat bang in.
english: Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

paite: Hoih sang in gilou na deihzaw a; diktatna thugen sang in zuauthu gen na deihzaw hi. Selah
english: You love evil more than good, lying rather than speaking the truth. Selah.

paite: Nang lei khemhat aw, thu mivalhtheite na deih hi.
english: You love all devouring words, you deceitful tongue.

paite: "Pathian in tangtawn a ding in ahon hihse ding a, ahon man ding a, na omna a kipan in ahon kaikhe ding a, mihing gam a kipan ahon botkhe ek ding hi. Selah
english: God will likewise destroy you forever. He will take you up, and pluck you out of your tent, and root you out of the land of the living. Selah.

paite: Midiktatte'n leng amu un alau ding ua, anuihsan ding uh.
english: The righteous also will see it, and fear, and laugh at him, saying,

paite: En dih uh, hiai mi ahi, akulhpi a Pathian nei nuam lou a, ahauhna thupi muang zaw a, gitlouh satlouhna akihihhat," chi in.
english: “Behold, this is the man who didn’t make God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.”

paite: "Kei zaw, Pathian inn a olive sel liahliah bang ka hi, Pathian zahngaihna tangtawn tangtawn in ka muang ding hi.
english: But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in God’s house. I trust in God’s loving kindness forever and ever.

paite: Huai na hih ziak in, tangtawn in kipahthu ka hon hilh ding; na misiangthoute mitmuh ah na min ka ngak ding, ahoih ahi."
english: I will give you thanks forever, because you have done it. I will hope in your name, for it is good, in the presence of your saints.
